original_human_message: Je valide DS01–DS10, RC1–RC4 et tes clarifications. Enregistre mes décisions, puis prépare la spécification technique avant l’implémentation. Garde v03, les 16 notes et les pilotes inchangés. Aucun commit ni push.
scope: Acceptance of DS01–DS10, RC1–RC4 and the four review clarifications as design decisions. Prepare technical specification only. No implementation, runtime activation, graph publication, new source/scientific approval or Git operation is authorized by this record.

decisions.statement: Start with an opt-in local deterministic adapter/typed renderer for the registered MabSelect bundles; no graph write or new model call
decisions.points_to_confirm_accepted: Keep r2, table/figure and comparison mappings out of this first release

decisions.statement: Use a documentary payload distinct from legacy symptom/cause/action paths
decisions.points_to_confirm_accepted: A procedure does not become a cause, trigger or capability; legacy chat and v03 are unchanged

decisions.statement: Treat original scoped human review, bundle admissibility and explicit serving release as separate gates
decisions.points_to_confirm_accepted: Q/N approvals stay question/context-specific; pending historical source flags are not rewritten; application-design approval alone is insufficient

decisions.statement: Require complete review/source bindings and all indispensable headings, conditions and warnings per option
decisions.points_to_confirm_accepted: A missing warning or invalid hash withholds that option; never supply an incomplete recipe

decisions.statement: Preserve three-valued applicability, uncertainty and exact product/phase/task ownership
decisions.points_to_confirm_accepted: Unknown is not true; category exploration is not diagnosis; no cross-task inference, default variant or conversion

decisions.statement: Preserve quantities, force, alternatives/sequences, examples, pH ownership and all reservations
decisions.points_to_confirm_accepted: Ordinary answers display necessary reservations; audit views retain original decisions/messages

decisions.statement: Require exact original citations plus a service-owned versioned excerpt view
decisions.points_to_confirm_accepted: No private file path dependency or full-PDF redistribution; exact quote hash is not semantic proof; printed and PDF page numbering remain distinct

decisions.statement: Separate clarification, scoped abstention, quarantine and integrity/service unavailability
decisions.points_to_confirm_accepted: Partial service is allowed only across independent complete units; global release failure blocks all tasks; counts/outcomes are derived

decisions.statement: Enforce quarantine/withdrawal, versioned release and deterministic selection/rendering limits
decisions.points_to_confirm_accepted: A model or user cannot approve a source, omit a prerequisite, select unknown IDs or inject executable instructions

decisions.statement: Use SC01–SC14 plus tamper/budget controls before any initial serving release
decisions.points_to_confirm_accepted: Cases are known-corpus conformance examples, not a new benchmark; later answering/architecture evaluations remain separate

decisions.original_proposal_markdown:
- **RC1 — First release medium:** local versioned bundle registry and excerpt view,
  using existing dossier/review artifacts. Defer Neo4j schema and public publication
  until the handoff is demonstrated. Contract acceptance does not itself authorize
  graph writes or default activation.

- **RC2 — Reader experience:** show product, explored category, conditional options,
  attached warnings and scoped reservations first; make the full original excerpt
  and audit trail one click away. Do not require a model to explain missing fields.

- **RC3 — Withdrawal authority:** before a release, designate the human-reviewed
  versioned withdrawal/revocation inventory checked during startup/lookup. Preserve
  prior records; a changed authority creates a new release. Existing review
  verifiers do not implement a universal revocation feed.

- **RC4 — Publication and future selection:** implement a model-free local handoff
  first. Only after its release checks should a separate opt-in chat route be
  considered, with a tool schema and deterministic selector that cannot broaden
  admitted support. No paid call is needed to validate this first handoff.

decisions.original_clarification_text: Autorité de retrait : toi comme valideur ; registre initial explicitement vide, sans supposer que les anciennes validations sont universelles.
Contrôle des versions : vérifier l’intégrité au chargement, puis vérifier à chaque requête que la version active et les retraits n’ont pas changé. Tout changement impose un rechargement.

Budget initial : fixer une limite configurable sur le dossier sérialisé complet. S’il dépasse cette limite, retirer l’option avec une raison explicite plutôt que couper ses conditions ou citations. La valeur numérique reste à choisir.

Activation locale : après les tests, préparer une version identifiée et son bilan pour ta revue avant activation. Cela ne constitue ni une autorisation de publier dans Neo4j ni une nouvelle approbation scientifique.
